title: World Cuisine Classes in the Base of the Mountains
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Come to the land of the mountains in Twin Lakes, Colorado. We will be cooking out of a casita in the foothills of Twin Lakes. We will be preparing food that is local and derived from this area and region. Come learn new techniques and enjoy some quaint atmosphere and lovely food.
